messages:
Rae: Quick thought: 'concierge fallback' pattern for tenants with strict residency. Resident region remains primary; if unhealthy we forward to a tiny concierge pool that enforces strict policies (no disk persistence, truncated outputs, no tool calls). Looking for implementation checklist.

Omar: Love it. Checklist item 1: signed consent token from control plane listing allowed fallback regions and allowed_features. Runtime must validate signature + TTL.

Lina: Ops items: per-tenant concurrency caps, global pool quota, and deterministic 429 with X-Fallback-Reason: capacity. Also expose X-Used-Mode in response headers.

Hector: Product asks for opt-in toggle and clear contract language. For some customers even read-only cross-border inference is disallowed. Must be explicit opt-in.

Rae: Dev header proposal: X-Residency-Mode: resident|concierge and X-Residency-Consent: <signed-token>. Guarded tenants -> 403 without consent.

Omar: Metric requests: concierge_fallback_granted_total{tenant}, concierge_fallback_denied_total, concierge_p95_latency. Alert if granted ratio > 0.5% per tenant over 10m.

Lina: Isolation constraint: concierge pool must not reuse model weight caches across tenants. Enforce ephemeral per-request load or strict namespacing.

Hector: Legal: KMS-scoped signing keys and audit logs with consent snapshot required. We'll draft amendment text.

Rae: Edge case: model pin mismatch. Runtime should consult a fallback map and either map to compatible variant or return FBACK_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE with suggested alternatives. Document mapping per family.

ops-bot: ops-bot: canary scheduled: concierge-pool:v1 -> limited @ 2024-09-05T02:00Z

Rae: Action items: Omar write token RFC (Mon), Lina run load sims + quotas (Wed), Hector draft opt-in UI + contract blurb (Tue), Legal to produce KMS guidance (Fri). I'll open RFC and link it here.

Omar: No objections. Will start the RFC.
